title: LocalFind Phase-0 corpus manifest
description: Lists every evaluation asset. Paths are relative to the corpus root (use --media-root in validate_corpus.py). No model-specific fields by design (R-07: evaluation stays model-agnostic).

version.description: Manifest version. Bump when assets or judgments change; P0-T007 records this version in benchmark reports.

corpus_root_note.description: Human note saying where the media lives (generated dir or private root). Never a machine-specific absolute path.

asset_id.description: Stable ID, unique in the manifest, e.g. 'img_004', 'vid_012'.

rel_path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the corpus root. Must not be absolute or contain '..'.

duration_ms.description: REQUIRED (>0) for video: measured clip duration in integer ms. Must be absent/null for images.

sha256.description: Optional content hash. The local generator fills it; private contributors may omit it.

license.description: Redistribution terms, e.g. 'synthetic-CC0' for generated media. Anything not freely redistributable must use distribute=false.

distribute.description: True only when the file may be committed/shared. Private assets use false and live outside git (see benchmarks/README.md).

provenance.description: How the asset was obtained, e.g. 'synthetic-ffmpeg:<generator-version>' or 'private-consented'.

description.description: What is visibly depicted. Judgments are written against this ground truth, not against model output.

generator.description: Present for synthesized assets: exact recipe so anyone can reproduce the bytes.
